verdict.rationale: Any service with public documentation and online filing could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to INPI. The evidence shows only human-oriented French procedural pages (trademark, patent, design filing guides) and nothing about llms.txt or agent-targeted documentation. The data.inpi.fr probe returned HTTP 403 to a keyless GET, which concerns data-portal access rather than agent docs, so it is not credited.
